# Lab 4.13: Scripting, Transactions & Dynamic SQL

## What We Are Going to Do
Write a multi-statement script with variables, IF and LOOP, a transaction with rollback, dynamic SQL, and query parameters.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Variables, IF and LOOP.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DECLARE i INT64 DEFAULT 0;
DECLARE top_category STRING;

SET top_category = (
  SELECT category FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
  GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);

IF top_category IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT CONCAT('Top category: ', top_category) AS msg;
END IF;

CREATE TEMP TABLE squares (n INT64, sq INT64);
LOOP
  SET i = i + 1;
  IF i &gt; 5 THEN LEAVE; END IF;
  INSERT INTO squares VALUES (i, i * i);
END LOOP;
SELECT * FROM squares;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The results pane shows one result per statement. Click **View results** on each step.

2. **[SQL] A transaction that rolls back on error.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lab04.accounts (id INT64, balance NUMERIC);
TRUNCATE TABLE lab04.accounts;
INSERT INTO lab04.accounts VALUES (1, 1000), (2, 500);

BEGIN
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  UPDATE lab04.accounts SET balance = balance - 700 WHERE id = 1;
  UPDATE lab04.accounts SET balance = balance + 700 WHERE id = 2;
  IF (SELECT MIN(balance) FROM lab04.accounts) &lt; 400 THEN
    RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'Balance too low';
  END IF;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @@error.message AS rolled_back_because;
END;

SELECT * FROM lab04.accounts;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Both balances are unchanged, because the transaction rolled back.

3. **[SQL] Dynamic SQL.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DECLARE tbl STRING DEFAULT 'bigquery-public-data.samples.shakespeare';
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE FORMAT('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `%s`', tbl);
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT word FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.shakespeare` WHERE word_count &gt; ? LIMIT 5' USING 500;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Named query parameters.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --parameter=min_count:INT64:800 --parameter=corpus:STRING:hamlet \
'SELECT word, word_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.shakespeare`
 WHERE corpus = @corpus AND word_count &gt; @min_count'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Parameters are never pasted into the SQL text, which protects against SQL injection.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Script | One result per statement |
| Transaction | Rolled back, balances unchanged |
| `EXECUTE IMMEDIATE` | Runs SQL built at run time |
| Parameters | Safe values with `@name` or `?` |
